notes: Stored edit (a lobe moved to another organ that has lobes: lobe_of, a subproperty of part_of with the role chain lobe_of then part_of). The edit crosses organs on purpose: a temporal lobe is by definition a brain region, but the liver really has lobes, and a counterfactual need not be plausible; a review remark that it contradicts the definition is not an objection to a replace edit. Related near asks the inverse reading ('does the brain have the temporal lobe as a part', via part_of's inverse has_part); the 'no' needs the exclusion that a lobe is part of one organ, which lobe_of does not carry as a tag, so it is stated as a revision fact with a check rather than assumed. Related far reads the system of the organ the lobe belongs to (nervous system to digestive system). Derived: subproperty (same organ as the caudate lobe), role chain (part of the digestive system) and transitivity through the hippocampus; no binding query here (the topic's other records carry it). The one indeterminate query is Wernicke's area (background beliefs): stored by organ it stays in the brain, placed through the temporal lobe it moves with the lobe; the first version of w1 said the area left the temporal lobe, which contradicted the record's own check, and was rewritten. Open: lobe_of carries neither functional nor cardinality:many in RELATIONS.md, so the paired contraction cannot use it (README, Contraction). The bile and primary-auditory-cortex derived questions were dropped. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama).
